title: Route TLS termination breaks with custom CA certificates
body:
After upgrading to v0.0.85, OpenShift Routes configured with custom CA certificates fail TLS termination.

This worked in v0.0.84. The gateway now rejects the certificate chain with:
```
certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate
```

Workaround: Use passthrough TLS instead of edge termination.

comments.body: This is blocking our staging deployment. We can use passthrough for now but need a proper fix.
